title: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
summary: This blog post provides an overview of the open model landscape in summer 2026, highlighting key releases, trends, and community developments in the Hugging Face ecosystem.
highlights: The open model ecosystem continues to grow rapidly, with new releases from both established labs and emerging startups.
Community-driven fine-tuning and evaluation have become standard practice, enabling rapid iteration and specialization.
Interoperability and standardization efforts are gaining traction, making it easier to deploy models across different frameworks.
